parts.name: Rule
parts.description: A rule: a line across the plot at a fixed value. It makes a `<g>` with a `<line>`, a `<text>` and a `<desc>`.

props.name: value
props.description:
The value of the rule: a number, a date, or a category of a band scale. A number or a date
goes into the domain of its axis. A value with no place on the scale makes no line.

props.name: axis
props.description: The axis of the value. The default is `y`: a horizontal line. `x` makes a vertical line.

props.name: label
props.description:
The text of the rule, for example "Target". The plot shows it at the end of the line. The
description of the plot and the data table give it with the value.

props.name: compare
props.description:
A function of a point and the value of the rule. Its text goes at the end of the name of the
point, for example "above target". An empty text adds nothing.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the group of the rule.

dataAttributes.name: data-rule
dataAttributes.description: On the group of the rule.

dataAttributes.name: data-axis
dataAttributes.description: On the group of the rule. The value is the `axis`.
